hypotheses.justification: `H n k` is `(neighborhood 1 (simplicialInitSeg n k)).card` (Cube.lean:490), so it is defined for every `k` and is at most `2 ^ n` by `H_le_cube`. Without `ha`, split on `a ≤ 2 ^ N`. If it holds, apply the existing theorem with `ha` and `hb`. If `a > 2 ^ N`, then `H_mono` and `H_full` give `H N a ≥ H N (2 ^ N) = 2 ^ N`. The right-hand side is at least `max (H N a) b + max (H N b) a ≥ H N a + a ≥ 2 ^ N + 2 ^ N + 1`. That is larger than `2 ^ (N+1)`, and `H (N+1) (a+b) ≤ 2 ^ (N+1)` by `H_le_cube`, so the inequality holds; `omega` closes it after rewriting `2^(N+1) = 2^N + 2^N` with `pow_succ`. The degenerate case N = 0 is covered by the same argument. The case split does not use `hb`'s bound when `a > 2^N`, so `ha` can be deleted on its own. The same argument works for `hb` (next entry), and in fact both can be deleted together.

This mirrors the argument for `ha`. Split on `b ≤ 2 ^ N`. If it holds, use the original theorem (with `ha`). If `b > 2 ^ N`, then `H N b ≥ H N (2 ^ N) = 2 ^ N` by `H_mono` and `H_full`. So the right-hand side is at least `b + max (H N b) a ≥ b + H N b > 2 ^ N + 2 ^ N = 2 ^ (N+1)`. By `H_le_cube (N+1) (a+b)` this bounds the left-hand side. All lemmas named are in LeanPool/BooleanIsoperimetry/Cube.lean (`H_mono` line 497, `H_le_cube` line 507, `H_full` line 519).
